def max_accordion_length(s):
    n = len(s)
    dp = [[0] * 4 for _ in range(n + 1)]
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0]
        if s[i - 1] == '[':
            dp[i][1] = dp[i - 1][0] + 1
        elif s[i - 1] == ':':
            dp[i][2] = dp[i - 1][1] + 1
        elif s[i - 1] == '|':
            dp[i][3] = dp[i - 1][2] + 1
    
    return dp[n][3] if dp[n][3] > 0 else -1
